mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_station_feedback_raw(source_id,payload_ciphertext,payload_nonce,payload_tag,key_id,algorithm,retention_until) VALUES(#{sourceId},#{payloadCiphertext},#{payloadNonce},#{payloadTag},#{keyId},#{algorithm},#{retentionUntil}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE payload_ciphertext=VALUES(payload_ciphertext),payload_nonce=VALUES(payload_nonce), payload_tag=VALUES(payload_tag),key_id=VALUES(key_id),algorithm=VALUES(algorithm), retention_until=VALUES(retention_until),deleted_at=NULL,updated_at=NOW(3)
